crudSummary.create: Register new customer and staff user accounts with secure password hashing (SHA-256); add new shipping, billing, and contact addresses to the user's address book.
crudSummary.read: View customer profiles, fetch stored address books, view login session history, and retrieve role-based access permissions for internal staff.
crudSummary.update: Edit personal details (name, phone, email preferences), update account passwords, set primary shipping destinations, and modify assigned staff roles.
crudSummary.delete: Remove saved addresses from the profile, deactivate customer accounts upon request, or terminate staff access records.

assignedErrors.name: Duplicate Email Registration Conflict
assignedErrors.condition: Triggered when a user attempts to register with an email address that already exists in the system database.
assignedErrors.message: An account with email "kasun.perera@gmail.com" is already registered. Please login or use a different email.

assignedErrors.name: Password Complexity Policy Violation
assignedErrors.condition: Triggered when a password submitted during registration or profile update contains fewer than 8 characters or fails to include both alphabetic letters and numbers.
assignedErrors.message: Password is too weak. It must be at least 8 characters long and include both letters and numbers.

assignedErrors.name: Invalid Sri Lankan Mobile Format
assignedErrors.condition: Triggered when the provided phone number does not conform to Sri Lankan mobile telecommunication network standards (07X-XXXXXXX or +947XXXXXXXX).
assignedErrors.message: Invalid Sri Lankan mobile number format. Expected 07XXXXXXXX (e.g., 0771234567 or +94771234567).

endpointsTested: POST /api/users/register - Register customer or staff user with hashed password
POST /api/users/login - Authenticate credentials and log session history
GET /api/users/:id - Fetch single profile with addresses
PUT /api/users/:id - Update name, phone, role, or status
POST /api/users/:id/addresses - Add new address to address book
